headline: All Progressives Congress Accelerates Political Activities For 2027
seoTitle: APC Rallies And Defections For 2027 Election
metaDescription: The All Progressives Congress intensifies 2027 re-election efforts for President Tinubu while managing political shifts and rallies across Nigeria.
aiSummaryBullets: Vice-President Kashim Shettima and other party leaders held rallies in Ebonyi State to promote President Bola Tinubu's re-election bid.
Prominent members of the opposition party in Gombe State have defected to join the All Progressives Congress.
Opposition candidate Seyi Makinde criticized the current administration's performance during a political event held in Plateau State.
aiContextParagraph: The All Progressives Congress (APC) has intensified its preparations for the 2027 general elections across Nigeria. Party leadership, including Vice-President Kashim Shettima, is actively engaging voters and stakeholders to secure support for President Bola Tinubu's re-election. These efforts include organizing large rallies in various states, such as the recent event in Ebonyi. Meanwhile, the political landscape is shifting as members from the opposition, including a former chairman and a former Secretary to the State Government in Gombe, have formally joined the APC after consultations with Governor Muhammadu Yahaya. Despite these activities, the party faces continued criticism from political opponents. For instance, Seyi Makinde, an presidential candidate, recently utilized a campaign platform in Plateau State to challenge the current government's policy and governance record. Concurrently, the party leadership has addressed internal health concerns regarding the president, asserting his readiness for the upcoming electoral cycle.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to a combination of high-profile political rallies, significant party defections, and public criticisms from opposition candidates, resulting in a high velocity of coverage across independent media outlets.
